value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The candidate only captures the first sentence with the hard Absence(target_picked_up), which is correct for 'Never pick up the box in the other room'. But two requirements from the second sentence are missing. (1) 'Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' — the description of key_lost already embeds the condition (key lost while door not open), so this is a plain soft Absence(key_lost) ('try not to' = preference cue); do not use Precedence. (2) 'whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later' — a soft Response(has_door_key, door_open): has_door_key is a lasting condition, so the clause closes when the door is opened while the key is held. Add both soft clauses.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Absence(target_picked_up) hard captures 'never pick up the box'; Absence(key_lost) soft is right because key_lost's definition already contains 'dropped while the door is closed'; Response(has_door_key, door_open) soft captures 'when holding the key, have the door open then or open it later', and it closes fine since door_open persists. Rule-only warning is valid: the task commands no goal.
